snapshot_encoding: All raw snapshot words below are hexadecimal strings. Fields follow docs/vmu-native-readahead-test.md; LOST packs loss indexes plus one, not completed CRC repairs.

source_interpretation.retained_failure_class: Incomplete overrun in a previously resumed block whose current receive area already has one loss recorded; finish refuses a second erasure and auxiliary abandonment follows.

software_experiments.double_overrun: Actual SCI/card/DMA and auxiliary fixture: injection at byte388 records loss390 with unrepaired1 and defers; second injection at458 returns POLL/OVERRUN and abandons with the lifetime count still1 and CRC/token counters0.
software_experiments.fresh_paused_pio: Scratch driver only: 12 modeled heartbeat visits append 12 CRC-checked blocks using fetch(next,256,true) from matching PAUSED; no DMA starts or guest DMA1 tuple changes, no extra CMD18/CMD12, no overrun/abandon/CRC/token errors, with channel2 active and the same DMA-overrun injection left armed.

next_experiment.scope: Optional read-ahead only; existing demand DMA reader remains unchanged.
next_experiment.transport: One fresh matching-PAUSED block through existing CPU-driven PIO per eligible controller heartbeat, then CRC check and cache append.
admission: TICK event only, never GD delivery or SCI IRQ
No VMU loan, port fault or unopened port
Valid cache space and same proven extent
Already-open CMD18 in PAUSED at the exact next physical block
Retain the existing guest DMA admission guard
Never use fetch(polled=true) as a RESUME fallback: that branch still starts DMA
next_experiment.risk: A complete PIO block consumes synchronous masked CPU time; modeled correctness does not establish acceptable frame timing or sufficient production bandwidth.

limits: Only first and last per-failure result records are displayed; intermediate POLL result codes are unknown.
Pre-operation hardware snapshots are sequential, not the final fenced counts used by finish.
Other DMAC channel activity was not captured at the actual hardware overrun; bus contention is a mechanism hypothesis, not an identified competing owner.
A recorded single loss denotes pending reconstruction, not a completed or CRC-validated repair.
Abandonment occurs before take/CRC, so zero cache CRC errors does not imply uninterrupted reception.
Cache hit and miss counts are feed visits, not unique physical blocks or byte hit rates.
No synchronized rendered-frame witness establishes that every visible hitch is caused by these exits.
Workloads differ from earlier videos; these counters do not establish a controlled performance improvement.
